source_message.text:
Read the full clipper guidelines here: <https://app.notion.com/p/Clipper-Guidelines-36c77021d09c8047b860e3c7aab7f8d4>

Watch everything inside — the introduction video, the good clip examples, the bad clip examples, and the brand guidelines. Do not skip anything. This is the most important step.

Then create 3 clips from one video on the YouTube channel. Each clip must:
\- Capture a complete moment from start to finish — not a fragment
\- Teach something or deliver a real lesson
\- Be clean and professional — no crazy effects, no transitions, just simple quality editing that follows the examples

If you pass, I hire you immediately on a flat $400-500 per month retainer for 125 approved clips per month. On top of that, I will personally train you to become a Lead Clipper — managing a team and earning up to $2,000 per month.

I really want to make this work. Take your time with the guidelines, watch all the examples, and send me 3 perfect clips.

4\. **Moments need to teach something** — every clip must capture a complete lesson or story from start to finish. Not a highlight, not a fragment. A full moment that makes sense on its own and leaves the viewer with something.

I have updated the guidelines with new example videos showing exactly what a perfect clip looks like and what a bad clip looks like. Go through everything again — every video, every example, every link. Do not skip anything.

You are halfway in Jafet. I am giving you this chance because I believe you can do this. But the next submission needs to be perfect. Go through the guidelines completely and redo all 3 clips.

I am rooting for you. Show me what you can do.

Cleavon

Hey,

Welcome — you are one of only 2 clippers hired right now. That means you are in from the start and have a real opportunity to grow with this from day one.

Let me answer your questions:

**What videos you will be editing:**
Teyron Alexina's long-form YouTube videos. You watch them, find complete moments — a full lesson, a story, a real point — and turn each one into a standalone 45-60 second clip for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.

**Deadline for the 100 clips:**
100 approved clips per month. That breaks down to roughly 3-4 clips per day. Consistent daily output is what keeps you on track.

**On the payment:**
The retainer is $400-500 per month for 100 approved clips. Approved means I review and approve every clip personally — only approved clips count toward the 100. On top of that you earn performance bonuses based on how your clips perform on Instagram — up to $500 on a single clip that blows up. So your earning potential is well above the flat fee.

Tomorrow I will send you everything you need — the full training material, the guidelines, and your assigned Instagram account. Get ready.

This is just the beginning. Let us crush this.

Cleavon

hy brother

B-roll link: <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lPMIpcCWSCVVjehwoijwEuSb7mu-BmQO>

Here is what I need from you:

Create **5 perfect clips** using this B-roll footage alongside Teyron's long-form YouTube videos.

Every clip must follow these rules exactly:
\- 45 to 60 seconds minimum
\- Captures a complete moment — full lesson or story from start to finish
\- B-roll used naturally to support the message — not randomly placed
\- White text only — no colored fonts, no effects on text
\- Clean simple editing — no heavy animations, no flashy transitions
\- Background music at low volume — never louder than Teyron's voice
\- Standalone — someone who has never seen Teyron before watches it and understands it completely

**DEADLINE: Thursday.** I need to review and approve every clip before they go live Friday. That means I need them in my hands by Thursday morning — not Thursday night. If I do not have them by then they do not get posted this week.

Move fast. The B-roll is there to make the message more powerful — use it where it adds to the moment, not just to fill space.

Send your 5 clips as a Google Drive folder link with your name as the folder title. Set it to anyone with the link can view.

These are the first real clips going live. Make them perfect.

Cleavon
